fact: The head of the health ministry's preventive medicine and public health sector wrote to every health directorate in the Republic requiring unified, better-quality data entry on the mechanised system for registering births and deaths at health offices, the unified QR-coded death notification form (January 2021 issue) in all hospitals and no other form, citing earlier instructions of October 2024; the article gives no date for the letter, so its publication date is used.
title: تحديثات جديدة بمنظومة إخطار الوفاة لتحسين جودة البيانات الصحية
